title: Carolina Collection Triple Glass Shelf, 16-Inch, Wall Mount, Solid Brass Hardware, Allied Brass
body_html:
Get three levels of bathroom storage without sacrificing counter space. This wall mount triple glass shelf keeps everyday essentials organized in a compact, traditional design.

  • Store more vertically: Three tiers provide dedicated space for toiletries and décor.
  • Clean, finished installation: Concealed screw mounting hardware keeps fasteners out of sight.
  • Built with enduring materials: Solid brass hardware paired with thick, beveled-edge glass.
  • Coordinate the room: Part of the Carolina Collection for matching Carolina traditional bathroom hardware and classic bath accessories.

Specs & Installation

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 inch
  • Weight capacity: 6 lb
  • Mounting: wall mount (concealed screws)
  • Assembly required: No
  • Included: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4 inch
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty
  • Finish options: Multiple designer finish options available
